plugin.name: Bully Widescreen Fix
camera.fovfactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view. 1.00 keeps the intended framing; higher values widen the view.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the Rockstar and Mad Doc logo movies at startup. Story movies stay. Applies at the next start.
display.fmv.description: Original aspect with black bars, cropped to fill the screen, or stretched.
display.window.description: Fullscreen, a window or borderless. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the last window mode.
display.hudconstraint.description: Auto uses the whole screen. A ratio keeps the HUD in a centered box of that shape.
display.CutsceneBorders.description: Bars above and below, side bars at the original aspect, both or none. Off crops without showing more.
display.AnimatedCutsceneBorders.descript: The cutscene borders slide in and out as in the original. Off shows them at once.
display.pausefocus.description: Pauses the game and its sound while the window is inactive. Off keeps it running.
controls.auto.description: Uses the controller or keyboard and mouse, whichever was used last, and finds controllers plugged in during play.
controls.speed.description: Multiplies the camera speed of the controller. 1.00 is the original speed. Mouse not affected.
controls.deadzone.description: Deadzone of both sticks. Lower responds sooner; raise it if the sticks drift.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while the game is active.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the fix's menu and of other plugins. Automatic follows the game.
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released, bugs fixed. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: all on. Press twice.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults. Press twice.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted in order to apply settings.
